rules.call_path: FUN_0045ddc0 constructs commands 0x6f..0x75 at fixed x positions and calls FUN_0045f100; displayed order follows those positions.
expected_outcomes: The full-index command is first, followed left-to-right by commands 0x70, 0x71, 0x72, 0x73, 0x74, and 0x75.
capture_needs: Capture the seven selectors for both factions and join localized labels to command IDs.

rules.call_path: FUN_00421c70 initializes shell +0x474 to null. FUN_00422620 creates it only while null, enumerates registry definitions through FUN_0051caf0/FUN_00567800, applies the recorded range and +0x5c tests, derives the low12+0x1000 key, deduplicates by key, then appends side-specific systems from FUN_004f31b0/FUN_004f6010 under the same key deduplication.
expected_outcomes: The cache is built at most once per shell object and later FUN_00422620 calls do not repopulate it.
Definition-backed and system-backed rows sharing a canonical key collapse to one row.
The cache is a registry-plus-side-system construction, not a fresh category-time campaign object snapshot.
capture_needs: Capture initial shell construction for both viewer sides and compare the cache-visible systems; runtime capture does not replace the static lifecycle proof.

rules.call_path: After the early returns and full-cache branch, FUN_0045f100 clears the reusable filtered collection, walks the already-built shell +0x474 cache, copies rows whose source-identity high byte lies in the selected half-open range, binds the filtered collection through FUN_00608280, and refreshes the control.
expected_outcomes: Family membership follows the recorded command ranges over cached rows.
Command 0x6f and eligible forced changes bind the full master cache rather than an empty list.
Definition gaps [0x20,0x22) and [0x40,0x50) do not appear in the inspected master cache despite broader outer selector ranges.
capture_needs: Capture each command's membership for both factions, including empty/gap cases and the 0x6f full-cache view.

rules.call_path: Both the shell +0x474 master collection and FUN_0045ddc0's filtered collection are constructed by FUN_0060a790 in mode 2. FUN_005f59f0 inserts through vtable +4, which resolves to FUN_0060a890; mode 2 compares row +0x14 text through FUN_00626ad0.
expected_outcomes: Rows sort ascending by case-insensitive narrow bytes, using ASCII folding without an active locale and the current CRT byte case map when locale handling is active.
Comparator-equal rows retain registry/system source insertion order because ordered insertion advances past equals.
capture_needs: Capture representative mixed-case and equal-folded names under the inspected locale; retain the exact byte comparator as the portable contract rather than claiming locale collation.

rules.call_path: FUN_0045f100 checks selected-command equality first, then topic-mode/nonforced state. Only after both early returns does command 0x6f or force bind shell +0x474 through FUN_00608280; current topic clears only when force is nonzero and mode is not topic mode. The remaining changed/nonforced/index-mode family path rebuilds the sorted projection.
expected_outcomes: Repeating the selected command is always a no-op, even when forced.
A changed nonforced command in topic mode is a no-op.
A changed forced command binds the master cache; it clears current topic outside topic mode and preserves it in topic mode.
A changed nonforced family command in index mode rebuilds the filtered view.
capture_needs: Capture same-command, changed-family, 0x6f, forced, and nonforced transitions in both index and topic modes.

rules.call_path: FUN_0045d400 resolves class context through FUN_0051cab0 and entity context through FUN_004f2d10, reads definition +0x30, derives (field & 0x0fff)+0x1000, and looks up that canonical key in shell +0x474. On an entity-key miss it invokes FUN_0045fd90, whose special [0xa0,0xb0) branch resolves through FUN_004f2f60 and either FUN_0040d760 or the associated +0x1c identity before retrying.
expected_outcomes: Raw entity identity is routing input and does not directly equal topic identity.
Class and entity contexts may resolve to the same deduplicated canonical topic key.
An unresolvable direct and fallback route produces no topic.
capture_needs: Capture class-backed, direct entity, [0xa0,0xb0) fallback, non-special fallback, and unresolvable opens without expanding into E07's exhaustive DAT joins.

rules.call_path: FUN_00422ce0 supplies empty wrappers to FUN_00429f30 for context-free opens; class/entity callers pass typed source context through FUN_0041d6b0 to FUN_00429f30 and FUN_0045d400, which applies canonical-key and fallback resolution before choosing index or topic mode.
expected_outcomes: Empty context opens the index.
A class or entity context whose canonical key exists opens that cached topic.
A context whose direct and fallback routes fail opens index mode without fabricating a raw-resource topic.
capture_needs: Capture context-free, resolved class/entity, fallback entity, and stale/unavailable opens for each owned family.

rules.call_path: FUN_00442130 installs vtable 0x00659ba0 and initializes row +0x6c enabled. Its +0x0c/+0x10 slots resolve to FUN_004ad730/FUN_004ad750, which walk next/previous links recursively past rows whose +0x6c is zero. FUN_0045da70 uses those slots for 0x84/0x83, and FUN_0045fd20 disables controls on null results.
expected_outcomes: Navigation follows the sorted bound collection and skips disabled rows.
A non-null enabled neighbor becomes current and is rendered.
A null result retains current topic, disables its direction, and never wraps.
capture_needs: Capture first, middle, disabled-intermediate, and last topics with pointer and keyboard input; verify title/body/art transitions.

rules.call_path: FUN_0045fa60 masks the source identity to 12 bits for families [0x40,0x80) and [0x08,0x10), adds 0x1000 for source side 1 or 0x2000 for source side 2, then calls FUN_0045f970.
expected_outcomes: Alliance selects the 0x1000 key family.
Empire selects the 0x2000 key family.
The same topic text identity is retained.
capture_needs: Capture the same applicable identity from both factions and compare the selected original image.

rules.call_path: For source families [0x90,0x98), FUN_0045fa60 resolves a system picture selector through FUN_004f3220 and FUN_00509610; FUN_0045f660 maps selectors 1..26 to ENCYBMAP keys 0x2b5c..0x2b75 before FUN_0045f970.
expected_outcomes: System art follows the 26-way source picture selector and is not derived from a resource-ID offset.
capture_needs: Capture representative selectors including the three non-sequential terminal cases.

rules.call_path: FUN_00422620 starts [0x90,0x98) enumeration through FUN_004f31b0/FUN_0053ef50 for shell +0x9c viewer side and advances through FUN_004f6010/FUN_0053f090 with exclusion enabled. The type-0x90 factory FUN_00566c70 calls FUN_00566b90, which installs vtable 0x00663698; its +0x10 slot resolves to FUN_004f6330. That predicate walks +0x1c container ancestry and returns nonzero when an ancestor's vtable +4 type is 0xf2. FUN_0053f090 rejects such a side view and continues. FUN_005696b0 installs the type-0xf2 vtable 0x006639b8, whose +4 slot FUN_00569880 returns 0xf2.
expected_outcomes: A selected system side view whose +0x1c container ancestry reaches virtual type 0xf2 is excluded.
A selected system side view whose ancestry reaches null without type 0xf2 is eligible for canonical-key deduplication and insertion.
The structural type-0xf2 test must not be renamed as knowledge, destruction, or visibility without separate evidence.
capture_needs: Capture the same systems from both sides with both ancestry outcomes, retaining the selected side-view and container identities; use the source code as the predicate name unless a higher-level meaning is separately proven.

rules.call_path: FUN_00422620 and FUN_0045f100 construct every admitted encyclopedia row through FUN_00442130 with +0x6c set to one; the encyclopedia paths have no later write that disables those rows. The neighbor vtable nevertheless skips any externally disabled row. Entries excluded from master-cache construction or absent by canonical-key deduplication cannot appear in projections or context opens.
expected_outcomes: Static asset presence alone does not make a topic available.
Admitted definition rows remain enabled in the recovered encyclopedia path; system admission is separately gated by the selected view's exact type-0xf2 container-ancestry predicate.
If a bound row is disabled by another connected owner, neighbor traversal skips it rather than stopping or wrapping.
capture_needs: Capture admitted, absent, and—if a connected writer can be found—disabled rows for both factions; do not label generic +0x6c as a gameplay knowledge flag without proof.

rules.call_path: The shell constructor zeros +0x474, FUN_00422620 populates it only under an if-null guard, and FUN_0045f100 only binds or filters that retained collection. No recovered encyclopedia selection path repopulates +0x474.
expected_outcomes: Same-category repeat is a no-op.
Changed-family selection rebuilds only a projection over the retained cache.
Campaign changes after cache construction do not add or remove master-cache membership during that shell lifetime.
capture_needs: Capture a shell across a controlled campaign change and after shell reconstruction to distinguish retained-cache behavior from a fresh shell build.

rules.call_path: Owned ENCYBMAP decoding maps Luke's canonical selector 0x1842 to EDATA.074, leaves 0x2842 empty, and contains no EDATA.192 value. Recovered REBEXE static evidence identifies the EDATA directory-literal reference at 0x0045f8d2 inside FUN_0045f7b0 and identified callers 0x0045fbef and 0x0046a2ff of the associated FUN_0045f970 external loader; those callers pass selectors resolved through ENCYBMAP and do not establish a connected EDATA.192 path.
expected_outcomes: EDATA.192 remains inventoried but unused for this inspected profile; no alternate-Luke predicate, runtime binding, UI switch, or original-display claim is published.
The standard source-proven mapping 0x1842 to EDATA.074 remains supported; deferral is not proof that other original behavior is impossible and does not block the first profile.
capture_needs: Deferred task orlocal-2kq retains the future need: after original-runtime/load tracing of this build, additional connected code/data evidence, or another legitimately owned profile establishes a selector/predicate, capture the same Luke identity before and after its proven state; current unconnected observations must not be staged as EDATA.192 proof.

work_packages.title: Tactical geometry, state art, meshes, and textures

retrieval.method: P54 stages all 87 type-301 meshes and 397 type-303 texture or palette resources with exact PE identities and hashes. P55 decodes the complete corpus into deterministic runtime objects and verifies mesh topology, bounds, materials, and texture names against Assimp 6.0.5 raw import. P56 packages one exact pair and proves WebGL submission. P57A implements the first three-resource LOD family and predicate. P57B1 proves the live cached-slot cycle. P57B2A recovers the initial faction camera, field and clip constants, zoom/orbit/pitch switch, handedness conversion, and four bitmap D-pad commands. P57B2B1 activates switch case 9, models the selected-object and resolved-frame contract, and uses target resources 1058/1059 in a muted browser journey. P57B2B2 recovers FUN_005ab650's active capital-ship and non-docked fighter-group counts, 100 + 3 * max(force count) battle extent, and four tactical lanes. P57B2B3 traces FUN_005a9030, binds stable DAT and unfiltered fleet-roster identity to production participants, reproduces the signed-zero alternating X-slot sequence and faction lanes, and targets the selected source-world point. P57B2C1 proves direct authored coordinates through FUN_005a9030, FUN_005adfa0, and FUN_005caf70, then packages palettes 5531 through 5557 and selects 5530 + SYSTEMSD.picture_id through FUN_00596ad0 and FUN_005c2e60. P57B2C2A recovers FUN_005d4d10's directional type 3 RGB 0.8 light at source frame (5,5,-1), Z-constrained origin target, ambient type 0 RGB 0.5 light, and transformed surface-to-light direction. P57B2C2B recovers FUN_005c1c10 and FUN_005d6e10 device behavior, default filtering, culling, depth, shading and specular state, plus diffuse/emissive material handling. P58A joins FUN_00597610_ship_db's source-named registry and FUN_005ab650's ordinal consumers to every CAPSHPSD and FIGHTSD identity, removes approximate sprite arithmetic, and browser-proves complete 87-mesh and 397-texture transport. P58B installs the complete tactical corpus in production, lazily loads exact joined capital families, and browser-proves two live participants rendered at recovered source positions. P58C traces FUN_005c7150, FUN_005c63f0, and 0x005d4af0; implements the exact type-303 fighter close, far, and indicator resources plus view-span thresholds 5 and 10; and browser-proves fighter pixels and projected capital interaction. P58D centers the fixture camera on each faction's live fighter and browser-proves the nine independent indicator, far, and close transitions through the original zoom controls without reloading either family. P58E traces the fighter group field, unassigned value, RGBY range, and side-dependent resource offsets; restores all task-force and fighter-group controls, source-shaped input, keyboard routing, and selected fighter portraits; and keeps automatic production grouping test-only until its algorithm is proven. P58F1 through P58F3 restore exact system-selected planet pairs, six target-impact families, all retained projectile geometry variants and lifecycles, and both tractor/gravity field families with source counts and shared priority. P58F4 binds source tactical ordinals to capital portraits 2001 through 2029, composites their lime mats over selected panel 1302, and renders live faction-correct shield and hull meters. P58F5 restores the five subsystem-condition bitmap families and exact quantization, placement, field-source identities, source-side capacity limits, priority, and frame reset. P58F6 traces FUN_005b54d0, 0x005b1970, 0x005b1ab0, FUN_005b05c0, and FUN_0040b8a0, then implements live shield overflow, hull loss, subsystem selection and hit limits, condition recalculation, and tractor cancellation. P58F7 traces FUN_005b0330, FUN_005b1490, FUN_005b16b0, FUN_005b1790, and FUN_005b17f0, then restores the 50-second repair cadence, inclusive damage-control roll, subsystem repair order, sublight-engine condition, and active tractor drag used by the mobility calculation. P58F8 traces FUN_005ad750, FUN_005afb70, FUN_005b2f30, FUN_005cd640, and the capital constructor direction state, then restores the maneuver-state bonus, effective-power velocity, signed movement, and 250-millisecond position integration. P58F12 traces both attack executor vtables, their shared stable-list walk, object-class slot, policy predicates, and event 0x36 target-link dispatch, then restores typed first-eligible target acquisition for capital and fighter owners.
retrieval.latest_verified_tranche: P58-B22 closes the bounded practical launcher implementation with one source-compatible tactical RNG stream, persisted power nibbles, exact completion/destruction callbacks, and the native timed trench-run producer.
